name: Grünes Band - Ost- und Südthüringen
description_md:
Gruenes Band Ost und Suedthueringen is a waymarked hiking route in Germany. The path spans a distance of 103.7 km with 2504 m of ascent and 2709 m of descent.

The route is signposted as GBT and forms part of the national waymarked hiking network. Walking the trail takes about 33 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is hard, which is derived from the distance and ascent.
